Using a Noise or realme watch

Keep your watch paired in its official companion app. That app must support writing steps and heart rate to Health Connect, with sharing enabled. Support varies by watch, app version, and region; Noise and realme compatibility is not verified here. Google Fit support alone does not confirm Health Connect sharing. Aasra does not pair with the watch over Bluetooth.
Not for diagnosis or emergencies. Seek medical help when needed.
Health data privacy

Aasra requests read-only access to steps and heart rate in Health Connect to display today’s steps and the latest heart-rate sample from the last 24 hours. Each metric is read only after you grant its permission. You can use the rest of Aasra without granting access.

This integration keeps health values in memory only while the health screen is active. It does not save health records, log them, upload them, or pass them to Aasra’s voice, AI, or cloud services. It saves only whether each permission was previously granted, to explain removed access. Original records remain with Health Connect and the apps that created them.

Checks stop when you leave the screen or the app is not active. You can remove Aasra’s access or manage original records in Health Connect settings at any time. Aasra does not write or delete health records. Installing Health Connect opens Google Play; no health values are included in that link.
